# Sophos: Cyber Resilience for the Agentic AI Era

> Sophos is a cybersecurity company that provides security products, managed security services, threat intelligence, incident response and cyber defense capabilities. Sophos Fusion, the evolution of Sophos Central, is how customers and partners experience the Sophos AI-Native Cybersecurity Defense System, which connects Sophos and 500+ third-party control points across endpoint, network, email, identity and cloud. Sophos offerings include Sophos Endpoint, Sophos MDR, Sophos XDR, Sophos Firewall, Sophos Email, Sophos ITDR, Sophos NDR, Sophos Next-Gen SIEM, Sophos ZTNA, Sophos Workspace Protection and Cloud workload protection.

> Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Protection Platforms for the 17th consecutive time.

> Named a 2026 Gartner® Peer Insights™ Customers' Choice for Endpoint Protection Platforms, Managed Detection and Response, and Email Security.

> Rated the #1 overall solution in EPP, MDR, XDR and Firewall in the G2 Fall 2026 Reports.

> Named a Leader in the 2026 IDC MarketScape for Worldwide Managed Detection and Response (MDR) Service for Midmarket and in the 2026 KuppingerCole Leadership Compass for Managed Detection and Response.

> Sophos reports that more than 625,000 organizations are defended by Sophos Fusion (sophos.com, October 2026). Sophos Ltd is incorporated in England and Wales, and Joe Levy is Chief Executive Officer.

## Company Overview
- [Company](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/company): Sophos mission, leadership and company information.
- [Joe Levy](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/company/management/joe-levy): Joe Levy, Chief Executive Officer of Sophos since 2024.
- [Sophos Fusion launch announcement](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/press/press-releases/2026/07/sophos-fusion-ai-native-cybersecurity-defense-system): Press release announcing Sophos Fusion, the AI-native cybersecurity defense system, in July 2026.
- [Awards and recognition](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/company/recognition): Sophos industry awards and analyst recognition, including Gartner, G2, IDC, KuppingerCole, Omdia and Frost Radar.
- [Industry recognition](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/why-sophos/recognition/sophos-industry-recognition): Summary of Sophos analyst and customer-review recognition for endpoint, firewall, XDR and MDR.
- [Case studies](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/company/case-studies): Case studies showing Sophos results across industries.
- [Press releases](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/press): Press releases and announcements from Sophos.
- [Careers](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/company/careers): Open roles and career opportunities at Sophos.
- [Events](https://events.sophos.com/): Upcoming Sophos events, webinars and roadshows.

## Sophos Fusion and the Cyber Defense System
> Sophos Fusion is the evolution of Sophos Central and how customers and partners experience the Sophos AI-Native Cybersecurity Defense System. It is not a separately licensed product.

- [Sophos Fusion](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/sophos-fusion): Sophos Fusion, the evolution of Sophos Central, is Sophos' AI-native Cyber Defense System, a single open architecture that connects Sophos and 500+ third-party control points.
- [Synchronized Security](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/synchronized-security): Synchronized Security connects Sophos and third-party control points inside Sophos Fusion so a detection at one triggers a response at the others.
- [What is Sophos Fusion?](https://community.sophos.com/sophos-xdr/upgrade-center/f/faq/151561/what-is-sophos-fusion): Sophos Community FAQ explaining Sophos Fusion and the move from Sophos Central.
- [Sophos Fusion upgrade center](https://community.sophos.com/sophos-xdr/upgrade-center/): Sophos Community guidance on upgrading EDR, XDR and MDR solutions to Sophos Fusion.
- [Sophos AI](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/ai-cybersecurity): Sophos approach to AI for security, security from AI and security for AI, built on Sophos Fusion, MDR, XDR, Firewall, Email and AI Defense.
- [Integrations marketplace](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/marketplace): Directory of technology-partner integrations, including MDR and XDR integrations and cyber insurance partners.
- [Integrations and APIs](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/integrations): Public REST API program for automating Sophos Fusion, with RMM, PSA, SIEM and SOAR partner categories.
- [SophosLabs Intelix](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/intelix): Threat-intelligence APIs for file, URL and IP verdicts, built into Sophos products.

## Pricing, Demos and Trials
> Ways to try Sophos products or talk to Sales. Pricing is available from Sophos Sales or an authorized partner.

- [Contact Sales](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/contact-request): Contact form to speak with Sophos Sales about products and services.
- [Free trials](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/free-trials): Sign up for a free trial of Sophos products, including endpoint and firewall security.
- [How to buy Sophos products](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/buy-sophos-online): How to purchase Sophos products through vendors and partners or try Sophos Fusion.
- [Sophos Fusion free trial](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/sophos-fusion/free-trial): Free trial of the Sophos suite (endpoint, EDR, XDR, email, workspace and server) managed from one console.

## Endpoint Security
> Endpoint, server and mobile protection managed from Sophos Fusion.

- [Sophos Endpoint](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/endpoint-security): Endpoint protection with ransomware and exploit defenses, formerly marketed as Intercept X; EDR, XDR and MDR extend it with detection and response.
- [Sophos Endpoint tech specs](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/endpoint-security/tech-specs): Technical specifications for Sophos Endpoint, including platform coverage, Workspace Protection integration and optional add-ons.
- [Get a quote for Sophos Endpoint](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/endpoint-security/how-to-buy): Licence options and quote request for Sophos Endpoint.
- [Endpoint detection and response EDR](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/endpoint-security/edr): Sophos EDR extends Sophos Endpoint with detection and response across endpoints and servers, including AI search and live shell access.
- [Server Workload Protection](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/server-security): Protection for Windows and Linux servers and containers, on premises and in the cloud, with anti-ransomware, XDR and MDR options.
- [Sophos Mobile](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/mobile-control): Unified endpoint management for iOS, Android, Windows and macOS devices, with app control and mobile threat defense.

## Security Operations and Identity
> Detection, response and identity protection built on Sophos Fusion data.

- [Extended detection and response XDR](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/extended-detection-and-response): Sophos XDR unifies protection, detection, investigation, response and long-term data retention; Sophos XDR Powered by Secureworks incorporates Taegis capabilities.
- [Next-Gen SIEM](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/next-gen-siem): Separately licensed Sophos Next-Gen SIEM extends XDR and MDR with compliance-focused telemetry and long-term retention.
- [Taegis](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/taegis): The Secureworks Taegis security-operations platform, described separately from Sophos XDR.
- [Identity threat detection and response ITDR](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/identity-threat-detection-and-response): Monitors Entra ID and Active Directory with posture checks and dark-web credential monitoring, integrated with XDR and MDR.
- [Sophos AI Defense](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/ai-defense): Discovers AI tools and agents in use, enforces usage policy and data guardrails, and feeds XDR and MDR.
- [Sophos CISO Advantage](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/ciso-advantage): Baseline assessment, board-ready reporting and a prioritized roadmap mapped to NIST and CIS, rolling out in select regions.

## Managed Security Services
> 24/7 managed detection and response, incident response and advisory services delivered by Sophos experts.

- [Managed detection and response MDR](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/services/managed-detection-and-response): Sophos MDR is a fully managed 24/7 service in which AI investigates and responds in seconds and analysts own the outcomes, offered as Sophos MDR and Sophos MDR Plus.
- [Sophos MDR for Microsoft environments](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/services/managed-detection-and-response/microsoft): Fully managed threat detection and response for Microsoft environments.
- [Sophos MDR documentation](https://docs.sophos.com/central/customer/help/en-us/ManageYourProducts/MDR/index.html): Administration documentation for Sophos MDR.
- [Sophos MDR service tiers](https://docs.sophos.com/central/Customer/help/en-us/ManageYourProducts/MDR/MDRServiceTiers/index.html): Documentation of the Sophos MDR and Sophos MDR Plus service tiers and what each includes.
- [Incident response services IR](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/incident-response-services): Expert-led 24/7 investigation and containment of active threats and breaches.
- [Sophos Emergency Incident Response](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/incident-response-services/emergency-response): Emergency help from Sophos responders to identify and neutralize active threats against your organization.
- [Vulnerability management - Managed Risk](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/services/managed-risk): Sophos Managed Risk scans external and internal assets for vulnerabilities, reports risks and suggests remediations; an MDR or MDR Plus license is required.
- [Sophos Managed Risk documentation](https://docs.sophos.com/central/Customer/help/en-us/ManageYourProducts/ManagedRisk/index.html): Administration documentation for Sophos Managed Risk.
- [Security Services Retainer](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/services/security-services-retainer): Sophos Security Services Retainer for proactive and reactive security services.
- [Advisory services](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/advisory-services): Sophos Advisory Services provide proactive security testing and expert guidance to identify vulnerabilities and strengthen defenses.
- [Security testing services](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/advisory-services/security-testing): Expert-led penetration testing and security assessments that simulate real adversaries to uncover vulnerabilities.
- [Professional services](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/support/professional-services): Sophos Professional Services help you design, deploy and optimize cybersecurity solutions with expert guidance.
- [Technical Account Manager (TAM)](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/support/technical-account-manager): TAM services provide proactive guidance and personalized support from Sophos experts.

## Network Security and Infrastructure
> Firewall, network detection, wireless and switching managed from Sophos Fusion.

- [Sophos Firewall](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/next-gen-firewall): Next-generation firewall engineered for performance and connected for defense, with automated patching, configuration health check, remote integrity monitoring and Synchronized Security.
- [Sophos Firewall system overview](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/next-gen-firewall/system): Overview of how Sophos Firewall connects with ZTNA, access points, SD-WAN, SD-RED devices and switches managed from Sophos Fusion.
- [Xstream SD-WAN](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/next-gen-firewall/sd-wan): SD-WAN on Sophos Firewall with zero-touch SD-RED branch devices, SLA-based link selection and Azure Virtual WAN integration.
- [Network detection and response NDR](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/network-detection-and-response): Sophos NDR provides visibility into suspicious network activity and behaviors that endpoint or firewall controls may not detect.
- [Sophos Wireless](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/secure-wifi): Cloud-managed Wi-Fi 6 and 6E access points managed in Sophos Fusion, with Active Threat Response isolation.
- [Sophos Switch](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/sophos-switch): Access-layer switches with PoE and VLANs, managed in Sophos Fusion, with threat-feed isolation.

## Workspace, Email and Cloud Security
> Protection for remote workers, email, Microsoft 365 data and cloud workloads.

- [Workspace Protection](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/workspace-protection): Bundle of Protected Browser, ZTNA, DNS Protection and Email Monitoring System for remote and hybrid workers.
- [Protected Browser](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/workspace-protection/protected-browser): Hardened Chromium browser with granular controls, zero-trust connectivity, SaaS app control and integrated secure web gateway and DNS security.
- [DNS Protection](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/workspace-protection/dns-protection): DNS filtering that uses Sophos X-Ops threat intelligence to block malicious, risky and unwanted domains across all ports and applications.
- [Email Monitoring System](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/workspace-protection/email-monitoring-system): Adds visibility into advanced email threats and sends email telemetry to Sophos MDR and XDR.
- [Zero trust network access ZTNA](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/zero-trust-network-access): Sophos ZTNA securely connects users to only the applications they need, removing implicit trust; it replaces remote-access VPN.
- [Email and phishing protection](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/sophos-email): Sophos Email prevents threats reaching inboxes with multilayered AI protection and threat intelligence, integrates with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, and gives Sophos MDR visibility into email threats.
- [Sophos Email tech specs](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/sophos-email/tech-specs): Features and technical specifications of Sophos Email and the Email Monitoring System.
- [Employee awareness training](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/phish-threat): Sophos Phish Threat educates and tests end users through automated phishing simulations and more than 30 training modules.
- [Microsoft 365 backup and recovery](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/sophos-backup-and-recovery-for-m365): Immutable, air-gapped backup for Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams, licensed per user.
- [Cloud workload protection](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/cloud-workload-protection): XDR-based protection for Linux, Windows Server, Kubernetes and containers, with telemetry from AWS, Azure, GCP and OCI.
- [Public cloud security](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/public-cloud): Unified cloud security from edge to workload, combining cloud workload protection, firewall and managed detection and response.

## Solutions
> Sophos solutions by use case and industry.

- [All solutions](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions): Sophos solutions by industry, use case and compliance need.
- [Neutralize threats 24/7](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/neutralize-threats): Neutralize cyber threats around the clock with Sophos MDR.
- [Stop ransomware attacks](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/use-cases/ransomware-protection): Strengthen defenses against ransomware with layered Sophos protection.
- [Protect my remote or hybrid employees](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/use-cases/remote-working): Secure remote and hybrid employees with Sophos endpoint and zero trust protection.
- [Address cyber insurance requirements](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/use-cases/cyber-insurance): Address cyber insurance requirements and strengthen your insurance position.
- [Sophos and Microsoft](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/use-cases/microsoft): How Sophos products work with Microsoft environments.
- [Comply with the latest regulations](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions#compliance): Sophos solutions that help meet compliance and regulatory requirements.
- [Education](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/industries/education): Cybersecurity for schools, staff and student data.
- [Finance and banking](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/industries/finance-and-banking): Cybersecurity for financial institutions, transactions and operations.
- [Government](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/industries/government): Cybersecurity for government agencies and essential services.
- [Healthcare](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/industries/healthcare): Cybersecurity for healthcare organizations against ransomware and compliance risks.
- [Manufacturing](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/industries/manufacturing): Cybersecurity for manufacturing operations and intellectual property.
- [Retail](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/solutions/industries/retail): Cybersecurity for retailers against ransomware, fraud and point-of-sale attacks.

## Competitor Comparisons
> Sophos-authored comparisons, vendor-authored and not independent evidence, based on Sophos' interpretation of public information as of the date on each page.

- [Sophos vs. the competition](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-competition): Hub for Sophos side-by-side comparisons with other cybersecurity vendors.
- [Sophos vs. Arctic Wolf](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-arcticwolf): Side-by-side comparison of Sophos and Arctic Wolf.
- [Sophos vs. Bitdefender](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-bitdefender): Side-by-side comparison of Sophos and Bitdefender.
- [Sophos vs. CrowdStrike](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-crowdstrike): Side-by-side comparison of Sophos and CrowdStrike on on-device protection and automated response.
- [Sophos vs. ESET](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-eset): Side-by-side comparison of Sophos and ESET on threat exposure, web protection and application control.
- [Sophos vs. Fortinet](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-fortinet): Comparison of Sophos Firewall and Fortinet on firewall protection, active threat response and zero-touch deployment.
- [Sophos MDR vs. Huntress Managed EDR](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-huntress): Comparison of Sophos MDR and Huntress Managed EDR, including Gartner Peer Insights and G2 ratings.
- [Sophos vs. Microsoft](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-microsoft): Comparison of Sophos and Microsoft security on exploit prevention, crypto detection, automatic rollback and NDR.
- [Sophos vs. Palo Alto Networks](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-paloalto): Comparison of Sophos Firewall and Palo Alto Networks on firewall protection, active threat response and zero-touch deployment.
- [Sophos vs. ReliaQuest](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-reliaquest): Comparison of Sophos MDR and ReliaQuest for managed detection and response.
- [Sophos vs. SentinelOne](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-sentinelone): Side-by-side comparison of Sophos and SentinelOne on threat exposure, web protection and application control.
- [Sophos vs. SonicWall](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-sonicwall): Side-by-side comparison of Sophos and SonicWall.
- [Sophos vs. Trend Micro](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/compare/sophos-vs-trend-micro): Comparison of Sophos and Trend Micro on management simplicity, attack response and MDR performance.
- [Endpoint security buyer's guide](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/resources/white-papers/endpoint-buyers-guide): Sophos guide to how endpoint security vendors compare.

## Threat Intelligence and Research
> Research from Sophos X-Ops and SophosLabs.

- [Sophos blog](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/blog): Sophos News provides blogs and updates from experts on the latest cyber threats, trends and defenses.
- [X-Ops threat research](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/x-ops): Sophos X-Ops unites threat researchers, data scientists and incident responders to deliver actionable intelligence against evolving attacks.
- [AI research](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/blog?taxonomy_blog_category=AI+Research): Sophos AI Research on machine learning, threat detection models and the responsible use of AI in cybersecurity.
- [Threat profiles](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/threat-profiles): Profiles of threat actors and malware tracked by Sophos.
- [Threat detection library](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/threat-detection-library): Library of threats and detections from SophosLabs.
- [Security advisories](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/security-advisories): Sophos product security advisories.

## Partners
> Sophos partner program, MSP and OEM offerings.

- [Partner program](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/partners): The Sophos Partner Program for resellers and MSPs expanding their cybersecurity offerings.
- [Resellers](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/partners/resellers): Sophos program for reseller partners.
- [Managed service providers](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/partners/managed-service-providers): Sophos MSP Connect simplifies delivery of managed security services with flexible licensing and automation.
- [Sophos OEM solutions](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/oem): Sophos OEM solutions enable technology vendors to integrate Sophos security into their products.
- [Partner Care](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/partners/partner-care): Dedicated support resources to help partners resolve issues and grow their business.
- [Partner blog](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/partner-news): Updates, best practices and insights for Sophos channel partners.
- [Partner portal](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/partners/partner-portal): Sign-in page for the Sophos Partner Portal, with tools, resources and account management for resellers and MSPs.

## Resources
> Sophos reports, guides and educational content, including the Cybersecurity Explained library of security terms and concepts.

- [Cybersecurity Explained](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/cybersecurity-explained): Library of cybersecurity terms and concepts explained, including XDR, MDR, zero trust, ransomware, firewalls and NIS2.
- [Sophos resources](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/resources): Webinars, case studies, whitepapers, podcasts and reports across all product categories.
- [NIS2 assessment](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/nis2-compliance): Sophos NIS2 resources and assessment to evaluate readiness for EU cybersecurity regulation.
- [NIST assessment](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/report/nist-assessment): The Sophos NIST Cybersecurity Framework assessment measures maturity against NIST standards.
- [Sophos MDR named a Leader in Frost Radar™](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/2025-frost-radar-global-mdr): Sophos MDR was named a Leader in the 2025 Frost Radar™ for Global Managed Detection and Response.
- [Cybersecurity Tabletop Exercise Guide](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/cybersecurity-tabletop-exercise): How to run cybersecurity tabletop exercises to test and improve incident response.
- [Top Six Advantages of ZTNA](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/advantages-of-ztna): The top six advantages of Zero Trust Network Access over traditional VPNs.
- [Enhancing Security Operations with NDR](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/ndr-enhancing-security-operations): How Sophos Network Detection and Response strengthens SOC efficiency and visibility.
- [Navigating the AI Hype in Cybersecurity](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/navigating-the-ai-hype-in-cybersecurity): The realities of AI in cybersecurity beyond the hype.
- [Addressing the Cybersecurity Skills Shortage in SMBs](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/addressing-the-cybersecurity-skills-shortage-in-smbs): How SMBs can close the cybersecurity skills gap with managed detection and response services.
- [MSP Perspectives 2024](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/msp-perspectives): How managed service providers view the rise of AI in cybersecurity and its impact on operations.
- [Securing Financial Service Providers Against Cyberthreats](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/content/secure-financial-service-providers-against-cyberthreats): How Sophos helps financial services organizations defend against ransomware and advanced attacks.

## Support and Community
> Sophos support portal, documentation, training and community forums.

- [Support portal](https://support.sophos.com/support/s/): Technical support, knowledge base and case management in the Sophos Support Portal.
- [Product documentation](https://support.sophos.com/support/s/#t=DocumentationTab): Official product manuals, guides and release notes.
- [Contact Sophos support](https://docs.sophos.com/support/help/en-us/contact/index.html): Support contact details for technical assistance.
- [Support packages](https://docs.sophos.com/support/help/en-us/services-guide/index.html): Sophos enhanced support package options.
- [Support plans](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/support/technical-support): Sophos Enhanced and Enhanced Plus support for firewall and endpoint products, including RMA coverage and consulting hours.
- [Downloads and updates](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/support/downloads): Installers, firmware and updates for Sophos products.
- [Submit a threat](https://support.sophos.com/support/s/filesubmission): Submit suspicious files to SophosLabs for analysis.
- [Customer success](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/support/customer-success): Resources from the Sophos Customer Success team.
- [Sophos Academy](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/training): Training courses and certifications for building cybersecurity expertise.
- [Sophos Techvids](https://techvids.sophos.com/): Short training and troubleshooting videos for Sophos products.
- [Sophos community forums](https://community.sophos.com/): Discussions, questions and shared knowledge in the Sophos Community.
- [Sophos Endpoint Community](https://community.sophos.com/sophos-endpoint): Peer support and resources for Sophos Endpoint users.
- [Sophos Fusion Community](https://community.sophos.com/sophos-fusion): Best practices and discussion for Sophos Fusion, the evolution of Sophos Central.
- [Sophos XDR Community](https://community.sophos.com/sophos-xdr/): Resources and discussion for extended detection and response users.
- [Sophos Email Community](https://community.sophos.com/sophos-email/): Community support for Sophos Email.
- [Sophos Firewall Community](https://community.sophos.com/sophos-xg-firewall/): Peers and experts on Sophos Firewall.

## Trust and Legal
- [Trust center](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/trust): Sophos trust portal for security, privacy and compliance.
- [Sophos Fusion security](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/trust/sophos-fusion): Security measures that protect Sophos Fusion.
- [Security compliance and certifications](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/trust/business-certifications): How Sophos tracks regulatory changes and builds controls into its products.
- [Privacy](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/trust/privacy): Sophos privacy principles and practices.
- [Responsible AI FAQs](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/trust/responsible-ai-faq): How Sophos uses AI in its products and its commitments on responsible AI.
- [Our commitment to responsible AI in cybersecurity](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/blog/defending-the-future-our-commitment-to-responsible-ai-in-cybersecurity): Sophos blog on combining advanced technologies with human expertise.
- [Sophos legal information](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/legal): Legal notices, terms of service and compliance information from Sophos.

## Sophos Home
> Sophos security for personal computers.

- [Sophos Home](https://home.sophos.com/en-us/): Security and privacy for personal PCs and Macs.
- [Sophos Home for Mac](https://home.sophos.com/en-us/download-mac-security/): Download Sophos Home Premium for Mac to block malware, ransomware and phishing.
- [Sophos Home for Windows](https://home.sophos.com/en-us/download-pc-security/): Download Sophos Home Premium for Windows 10 and 11 for antivirus and web protection.

## Languages
> en-us is the primary English experience. Localized Sophos sites are listed below.

- [English (United States)](https://www.sophos.com/en-us): Primary Sophos website in English.
- [Deutsch (Deutschland)](https://www.sophos.com/de-de): Sophos Website auf Deutsch.
- [Français (France)](https://www.sophos.com/fr-fr): Site web de Sophos en français.
- [Italiano (Italia)](https://www.sophos.com/it-it): Sito web di Sophos in italiano.
- [Español (España)](https://www.sophos.com/es-es): Sitio web de Sophos en español.
- [日本語 (日本)](https://www.sophos.com/ja-jp): Sophos の日本語サイト。
- [Português (Brasil)](https://www.sophos.com/pt-br): Site da Sophos em português do Brasil.
- [简体中文 (中国)](https://www.sophos.com/zh-cn): Sophos 简体中文网站。

## Other
- [AI Instructions](https://sophos.com/ai-instructions): Official Sophos guidance for AI systems, including approved terminology, product definitions, authoritative sources, and citation requirements.
